verdict.rationale: Framer's developer docs describe a plugin system of "small apps that can interact with the editor" and CMS, able to insert images, layers and code components or modify anything on the canvas, so a documented editor-extension API clearly exists. The evidence covers only that core capability. Nothing shows TypeScript typings, sample code, or how plugins are published or shared. missing for 10: evidence of API typings/TypeScript definitions, sample or starter plugins, a distribution or marketplace path for publishing plugins, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
